identificationModule.briefTitle: Orelabrutinib in the Treatment of HP-positive Gastric MALT Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Orelabrutinib in the First-line Treatment of HP-positive Gastric MALT Lymphoma: a Multicenter, Open-label, Randomized Controlled Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Describe the efficacy and safety of Orelabrutinib in the treatment of HP-positive gastric MALT lymphoma
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This multicenter, open-label, randomized controlled trial is trying to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Orelabrutinib in the first-line treatment of HP-positive gastric MALT lymphoma

armGroups.label: Experimental group
armGroups.description: Triple therapy for eradication of Helicobacter Pylori+Orelabrutinib
interventionNames: Drug: Triple therapy for eradication of Helicobacter Pylori and Orelabrutinib

armGroups.label: Control group
armGroups.description: Triple therapy for eradication of Helicobacter Pylori
interventionNames: Drug: Triple therapy for eradication of Helicobacter Pylori

interventions.name: Triple therapy for eradication of Helicobacter Pylori and Orelabrutinib
interventions.description: Triple therapy for H. pylori (oral administration for 2 weeks, followed by a 1-week break) plus Orelabrutinib for 8 weeks (or until progression, intolerable toxicity, death, or withdrawal from the study)

interventions.name: Triple therapy for eradication of Helicobacter Pylori
interventions.description: Triple therapy for H. pylori (oral administration for 2 weeks, followed by a 1-week break)

primaryOutcomes.description: the ratio of numbers of patients with complete response to all the participants receiving treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: the ratio of numbers of patients with complete response to all the participants
the period from the date of patients sign informed consent to the observed progression of the disease or the occurrence of death for any reason
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: the period from the date of patients sign informed consent to the observed event for any reason
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of first documented event, progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: time between the date of patients sign informed consent and the date of death or the date of last follow-up time
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of death or the date of last follow-up time, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.description: Record the name of adverse events and number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Throughout the treatment period, up to 6 months

otherOutcomes.timeFrame: Throughout the treatment period, up to 2 years
